notes.title: Version 1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Parkour Mode[/h2]
Parkour is getting an upgrade! Beyond the existing lobby maps, we’re excited to introduce a dedicated Parkour Mode. [b]Docks[/b] is our first map for this new mode and it features our new modifiers system.
[b]Learn more [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2119590/view/4704662705456707951]HERE[/url].[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43155376/9f9ca24f0cd3b7f7985073de1d8f5468237b7576.png[/img]

[h2]Abilities[/h2]
Abilities are powers that can be enabled by the host, adding extra layers of strategy to all the roles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43155376/100ad37fbc6b1e66f3079e3e137844ebedd494eb.png[/img]
[b]Meeting Admin[/b]
Take charge of the meetings! This ability allows you to silence one player for the remainder of the meeting.

[b]Locksmith[/b]
Lock doors for 25 seconds, opening strategic moves for both Imposters and Co-workers. Locksmiths can also unlock these doors.

[b]Identity Thief[/b]
Disguise yourself as another player for 25 seconds. Both players are silenced during this time.
[i]Identity theft is not a joke, Jim! - Dwight[/i]

[h2]The Court[/h2]
Take a break and shoot some hoops between rounds!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43155376/7dd7e5cc33d284a313f74606ad0cf708a8dc3027.png[/img]

[h2]Jester Role[/h2]
The Jester has arrived! Trick your way to victory by getting voted out to win the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43155376/c0900a013940926084ef042c5c5701589741b4bd.png[/img]

[h2]New Cosmetics[/h2]
Many more exciting cosmetics to unlock!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43155376/efc0b08aafcbe67a23076e8cbb0cdc379f0483a9.png[/img]

[h2]Parkour Points[/h2]
Introducing a new cosmetic currency earned by playing parkour. Use your points to unlock exclusive items that can't be obtained any other way. Have fun collecting!

[h2]Silly Slots[/h2]
Try your luck with the Silly Slots, a cosmetic slot machine where you can hit it big or waste your D-Bucks!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43155376/c3db7aa599506e5e5877b450861896f236c5b498.png[/img]

[h2]???[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43155376/51c8944c3a21412726eb648b4785afdd2de791e7.png[/img]

[h2]Full Translations & Partial Controller Support[/h2]
Enjoy the game with complete translations, now including Indonesian!


[h2]Changelist[/h2]
[b]Features:[/b]
- Added Jester role
- Added Abilities: Locksmith, Meeting Admin, and Identity Thief
- Added new Parkour gamemode
- Added Docks parkour map
- Added parkour Checkpoint, Mystery Item, and Hazards modifiers
- Added ability for host to end Parkour Mode matches
- Added new desk cosmetics
- Added new character cosmetics
- Added "Silly Slots" cosmetic slot machine
- Added basketball court "The Court" in the lobby
- Added score tracking to "The Pit"
- Added dedicated weapon inventory slot available to specific roles
- Removed 1 general inventory slot
- Added auto-complete tasks for ghosts
- Added Parkour Points currency used for unlocking cosmetics
- Added option to "Reset" while running parkour
- Added Indonesian translations
- Added full in-game text translations
- Added a new secret location
- Added interactable doors on Construction and Courthouse map
- Added a 10-second countdown sound effect to meetings
- Added Toggle setting for push-to-talk


[b]Improvements:[/b]
- Moved player list to in-game menu
- Changed "Open Map" default binding to Tab
- Lobby codes are no longer case-sensitive
- Added ability to preview cosmetics between purchasing and equipping
- Vote-to-kick now shows who started the vote
- Construction map max player count increased to 16
- Added vents to Casino map
- Made layout changes to Casino map
- Hugely increased the likelihood of winning "Lucky Spin" on Casino
- Changed role assignment randomization
- Fixed Supervisor role not functioning in meetings
- Upgraded porta-potties

notes.title: Introducing Parkour Mode
notes.content:
[h1]New Gamemode: Parkour Mode[/h1]
Parkour is getting an upgrade! Beyond the existing lobby maps, we’re excited to introduce a dedicated Parkour Mode. Now players can jump into expansive maps with new features!

[h1]New Map: Docks[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43155376/66013ee982f6fb3ce3994821e95449729cae1b9f.png[/img]

[h3]Our Biggest Parkour Map Yet![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43155376/3b348b129f12d5a605ab2ece8e177aaa124766af.png[/img]

[h1]Modifier System[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43155376/b746d8c74af21830b6a523bcc19e501c11a1508a.png[/img]

Parkour Mode introduces a Modifier System with three categories: [b]None[/b], [b]Weekly[/b], and [b]Custom[/b]. Compete on global leaderboards in the [b]None[/b] and [b]Weekly[/b] categories.

The [b]Weekly[/b] modifiers bring a fresh twist each week, giving players a new ruleset to master. Think of it as a dynamic challenge, similar to the Daily and Biweekly Gyms, but instead of new maps, you’ll face unique modifier combinations every week.

[h2]Mystery Items[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43155376/204b8ba085527d64f85f4f1094b62236d13ae646.png[/img]

[h2]Hazards[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43155376/5c97bb914fac2f143dcab5bd744d94d16f24d8a2.png[/img]

[h2]Checkpoints, and more![/h2]



We hope you enjoy the new content! Join our parkour community on [b][url=https://discord.gg/VFPXZ8Z]Discord[/url][/b].

notes.title: CASINO UPDATE
notes.content:
[h2]CASINO IS HERE![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43155376/c0b56e6bb14207c1054ceb35a6dc365167939bc8.png[/img]
This map is unlike any other in Deducto! The wide open spaces give it a different feel. Hope you guys enjoy this map that [b]supports up to 16 players[/b]!

[h2]16 PLAYER LOBBIES[/h2]
New, large lobbies with up to 16 players! We will be listening to feedback on what you guys think of large lobbies - this is a bit of an experiment.
[b]Note: Old maps do not support >10 players[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43155376/a9ea5f6122fdda7f0f04ee1b4e3d9ab50c463fbb.png[/img]

[h2]CHAOS MODE[/h2]
What if there were no meetings to vote out imposters, but instead everyone had a weak weapon to take justice into their own hands? Welcome to chaos mode, where you vote with your gun!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43155376/aa5edab142aaef54d1f2cc30497ee4a7110a8329.png[/img]

[h2]RED ROOM[/h2]
This is a refreshed Red Room that has some differences from Deducto 1. The course has a similar layout and has a bit higher difficulty.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43155376/5cc0d466ca1882c24dee85d8fa1c23ef614405df.png[/img]

[h2]BIWEEKLY GYM[/h2]
In addition to our daily parkour course, we have a new, longer course that changes every two weeks! See you guys on the leaderboard!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43155376/a19ae2eb6a084eebaac9cffd68505c8153be4447.png[/img]

[h2]NEW COSMETICS[/h2]
New cosmetics include the return of [b]Horse Head[/b], and new additions such as [b]Tuxedo Outfit[/b]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43155376/689a8701e09404a1b1f7b8ffbbc36935f8569490.png[/img]

Remember to [url=https://discord.gg/VFPXZ8Z]join our discord[/url], to more easily find players to match with!

notes.title: Launch Date, Features, and Final Playtest!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Deducto 2 Launches on June 15th! 🚀[/b][/h2]

[h2][b]💲 Only $5 USD[/b][/h2]
After careful consideration, we've set the price for Deducto 2 at an affordable $5. Our goal is to make the game accessible to as many players as possible while still fairly compensating our hardworking team. We hope you're as excited about this as we are!


[h2][b]🚫 No Microtransactions[/b][/h2]
Deducto 2 will not include microtransactions. Instead, players can unlock most in-game cosmetics using DBucks, an in-game currency earned through progression. While we don't plan to add microtransactions, we will offer a post-launch DLC called the "VIP Bundle." This bundle may include exclusive cosmetics, parkour courses, and a community status symbol, among other rewards!


[h2][b]🗺️ Revamped Maps[/b][/h2]
Deducto 2 brings you updated Office & Construction Maps, featuring new tasks, layout changes, and more. We're also excited to introduce an all-new map: Courthouse!


[h2][b]⚖️ The Courthouse[/b][/h2]
Put your friends' testimonies to the test in the exciting new Courthouse map, which offers fresh tasks, a new jail system, and the Judge role.


[h2][b]🧟 Infected Mode Update[/b][/h2]
Initially, we announced an Infected Mode for Deducto 2. However, after further development, we've decided not to include it at launch. Game development often requires changes in direction, and we felt this mode wasn't meeting our expectations. We may revisit the idea in the future, but it's not part of our current plan.


[h2][b]🎯 Final Playtest[/b][/h2]
📅 Mark your calendars for the last playtest before launch, taking place on the weekend of May 26th! 📅 The playtest will feature only the Courthouse map. Your feedback will be invaluable in helping us prepare for launch, so please join the playtest and share your thoughts, feedback, and bug reports.

[b][url=https://discord.gg/VFPXZ8Z]Join our community on Discord! 🎉[/url][/b]
